senses.gloss: दिव्य- + अंशु दिव्य- + अंशु, m. the sun.
दिवस- + अन्तर दिवस- + अन्तर, adj. one day old, MBh. 11, 98.
दिवा- + अन्ध दिवा- + अन्ध, m. An owl, Pañc. 158, 22.
दिन-, दिवस- + कर दिन-, दिवस- + कर, and दिवा-, m. the sun, Bhartṛ. 2, 65.
दिवा- + कीर्ति दिवा- + कीर्ति, m. a man of a low or impure caste, a Caṇḍāla, Man. 5, 85.

दिव्य- + चक्षुस् दिव्य- + चक्षुस्,
 I. n. a divine, i. e. a prophetic eye, Daśak. in Chr. 179, 7.
 II. adj. having a divine eye, Ragh. 3, 45.
दिवा- + चर दिवा- + चर, adj. walking by day, Man. 3, 90.

1. दिव् दिव्, i. 4, दीव्य, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm. MBh. 4, 533),
 1. To play at dice, MBh. 3, 2260.
 2. To play, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 2.
 3. With the instrumental and dat. of the stake, MBh. 2, 2061; 4, 533.
 4. To shine, Bhāg. P. 3, 20, 22.
 5. † To praise.
 6. † To be glad.
 7. † To be mad.
 8. † To be sleepy.
 9. † To desire.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. द्यूत, n.
 1. Gaming with inanimate things, Man. 9, 221.
 2. Game at dice, Nal. 9, 2.
 3. Battle, MBh. 7, 1350.
 4. The prize of a combat, MBh. 7, 3996.
 --Comp.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. देवितव्य, To be played at dice, MBh. 2, 2493. n. Game at dice, 5, 894.
 --With the prep. अति अति, To lose at play, MBh. 2, 2041.
 --With प्र प्र, To play, MBh. 8, 4210.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To [] throw dice in one's turn, MBh. 5, 137.
 --With वि वि, To lose at play, MBh. 2, 2384.

2. दिव् दिव्, i. 1 and 10, Par. † To pain.
 --i. 10, Par. † To beg.
 --i. 10, Ātm. To suffer pain.
 --With the prep. परि परि, i. 1, Par. and Ātm. (see देव्), To lament, Hariv. 3687.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. परिद्यून, Miserable, MBh. 5, 3175.
 --Caus. and i. 10, Ātm. देवय, To lament, Rām. 2, 40, 37.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. परिदेवित, Miserable, MBh. 4, 807. n. Lamentation, MBh. 1, 6199.

3. दिव् दिव्, the base of many cases is द्यु, of the nom. and voc. sing. द्यो (m. ved. and), f.
 1. Heaven, Man. 8, 86.
 2. Day, Varāh. Bṛh. S. 21, 8.
 3. Splendour, Bhāg. 3, 8, 23.
 --Cf. Ζεύς (= द्यौस्), Διός (= दिवस्), ἔν-διος, πρώϊζος, χθι-ζός, ἤδη (cf. अ-द्य; Lat. hodie), δήν, cf. Lat. jam, dum, du-dum, etc.; Lat. dies, Ju-piter, Jovis, etc.; O.H.G. zies-tac; A.S. tiwes daeg.

दिव 1. दिव् + अ, n.
 1. Heaven, MBh. 3, 11746.
 --Cf. त्रि-, n. Heaven (perhaps properly the third, the most holy heaven), Man. 9, 253.

दिवा दिव् + आ, originally instr. of दिव्, adv.
 1. By day, Man. 4, 50.
 --Cf. Lat. diu, du-dum, and दिवातन.

दिवंगम दिवंगम, i. e. दिव + म्-गम, adj.
 1. Rising to heaven, MBh. 4, 1526.
 2. Leading to heaven, 3, 11135.

दिवस दिवस, i. e. 1. दिव् + अस् + अ, m. and n. Day, Sāv. 4, 2.
 --Comp.
दिवस्पति दिव् + अस्-पति, m. A name of Indra, Bhāg. P. 8, 13, 32.

दिवातन दिवा + तन, adj., f. नी, Diurnal, Kumāras. 4, 46.
 --Cf. Lat. diutinus.
दिवाशयता दिवाशय + ता, i. e. दिवा-शी + अ + ता, f. Sleeping by day, Rājat. 5, 252.
दिविगत दिव् + इ-गत (vb. यम्), adj. Being in heaven, Hariv. 5150.
दिविचारिन् दिव् + इ-चारिन्, adj. Celestial, Rām. 5, 2, 14.
दिविज दिव् + इ-ज, m. A deity, Bhāg. P. 5, 2, 6.
दिविषद् दिविषद्, i. e. दिव् + इ-सद्, m. A deity, Lass. 66, 3.
दिविष्टि दिविष्टि, i. e. दिव्-इष्टि, f. Sacrifice, Chr. 288, 9 = Rigv. i. 48, 9.
दिविष्ठ दिविष्ठ, i. e. दिव् + इ-स्थ, and दिविस्थ दिव् + इ-स्थ, adj., f. ठा, था, Dwelling in heaven, MBh. 1, 2340; Bhāg. P. 4, 23, 22.
दिविस्पृश् दिव् + इ-स्पृश्, adj. Touching heaven, Nal. 12, 37.
दिविस्पृशन्त् दिव् + इ-स्पृशन्त् (pres. ptcple. of स्पृश्), Touching heaven, Bhāg. P. 7, 8, 22.
दिवोदास दिवोदास, i. e. दिव् + अस्-दास, m. A proper name, Chr. 297, 14 = Rigv. i. 112, 14.
दिवौकस दिवौकस, i. e. दिव-ओकस् + अ, m. A deity, Hariv. 11884.

दिव्य दिव् + य,
 I. adj., f. या.
 1. Celestial, Chr. 290, 3 = Rigv. i. 64, 3.
 2. Divine, Bhag. 11, 8 (prophetic).
 3. Magical, Bhartṛ. 2, 18.
 4. Brilliant, Rām. 1, 4, 26.
 II. n.
 1. An ordeal, Yājñ. 2, 22.
 2. Oath, Hit. 133, 3.
 --Cf. δῖος; Lat. divus.
दिव्यक दिव्य + क, m. A kind of snake, Suśr. 2, 265, 19.
दिव्यता दिव्य + ता, f. Divine nature, Kathās. 6, 82.

दिव्य- + दृश् दिव्य- + दृश्,
 I. adj. knowing the celestial phenomena, Varāh. Bṛh. S. 5, 13.
 II. m. An astrologer, 54, 31.
दिव्य-नारी दिव्य-नारी, f. an Apsaras, Rām. 2, 91, 19.
दिवा- + भीत दिवा- + भीत, m. 1. an owl, Kumāras. 1, 12. 2. a thief. 3. any flower, the petals of which close in the daytime.
दिवा- + भीति दिवा- + भीति, m. an owl.
दिवा- + भूत दिवा- + भूत, adj. become as clear as the day, MBh. 14, 1757.

दिव्य- + मानुष दिव्य- + मानुष, m. a demigod, Kathās. 1, 47 (एकान्तसुखिनो देवा मनुष्या नित्यदुःखिनः; दिव्यमानुषचेष्टा [] तु परभागेन हारिणी. विद्याधराणां चरितम् अतस् ते वर्णयाम्य् अहम्; The gods are ever happy, men ever unhappy; [but] the doing of the demigods is charming in the highest degree. Therefore, I shall tell you the adventures of Vidyādharas).
दिवा- + मैथुनिन् दिवा- + मैथुनिन्, adj. having sexual intercourse by day, Mārk. P. 14, 74.
दिवस- + विगम दिवस- + विगम, m. the decline of the day, Megh. 77.
दिवा- + शय दिवा- + शय, adj. sleeping by day, Ragh. 19, 34.
दिव- + स्पृश् दिव- + स्पृश्, and नभस्-, adj. touching or reaching to the heavens, MBh. 1, 2854; 11, 133.
दिवा- + स्वप्न दिवा- + स्वप्न, adj. sleeping at day, Hit. iii. d. 110.
दिवा- + स्वप्न दिवा- + स्वप्न, m. sleeping by day, Man. 7, 47.
दिवा- + स्वपन दिवा- + स्वपन, n. sleeping by day, Suśr. 1, 330, 8.
दिवा- + स्वाप दिवा- + स्वाप, m. sleeping by day, Suśr. 1, 330, 5.
